The '''RGL-80A electronet grenade launcher''' was a type of [[Stun net/Legends|stun net]] [[Net gun/Legends|launcher]] manufactured by [[Golan Arms/Legends|Golan Arms]]. A larger version of the company's [[RL-40 stun net launcher]], the weapon held a magazine of five [[RGL-80 electronet grenade|electronet grenades]], and had a maximum range of five hundred [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. Similar to the [[Pistol/Legends|pistol]]-sized RL-40, the RGL-80A could vary the intensity of the electrical shock delivered by means of a remote control.<ref name="EGWT" />
